## Global Instructions

# Conventions

- Never write a secret value into a file, commit, log or pull request. Reference it by name from the environment or the deployment's secret store.
- Deliver through a pull request against `development`: push a branch and open the pull request. After a push, check the commit is on the remote (`git merge-base --is-ancestor <sha> origin/<branch>`). Never force-push a shared branch.
- Several sessions can share one working tree. Commit only the paths you wrote (`git commit -- <paths>`), never `git add -A`, `git add .` or `git commit -a`; the `stage-explicit-paths` hook blocks them.
- Open a file with your file-reading tool, not `cat`, `head` or `sed` in a shell: a rule scoped to a path loads only when that tool reads a matching file.
- Write Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`, `refactor:`) with an optional scope, one change per commit.
- Renovate owns dependency versions: review its pull requests instead of bumping what it manages.
- No comments in code. Carry intent in names, types, small functions and tests; reasoning goes to `docs/` or an ADR. Machine-read directives stay: shebangs, `# syntax=`, `# renovate:`, schema hints, `@ts-*`, `eslint-*`, `# shellcheck`, `# noqa`, `//go:*` and doc comments a tool reads.
- Docs live in MkDocs under `docs/` and an application's `docs/`, and change with the behaviour. Durable knowledge goes into the repository, never into agent memory.
- Say plainly which gate failed or was skipped, and check the primary source before claiming something works or never worked.
- Name no employer or client, nor their hosts, ids or people, in this repository.
- The Bash tool may run zsh: quote variables, use arrays, `set -o pipefail` before gating on a pipeline, and close stdin (`< /dev/null`) for CLIs that may read it.

# Unfold

Unfold turns units of work (Work Items) into pull requests that are ready for human review. Ploeg (`apps/ploeg`, Go) authorizes, budgets and executes every agent Run. The Unfold application (`apps/unfold`, TypeScript) is where people define, follow and review that work ([ADR-0002](https://github.com/unfold-hq/unfold/blob/development/docs/adr/adr-0002-ploeg-is-the-only-engine.md)). Use the [glossary](https://github.com/unfold-hq/unfold/blob/development/docs/reference/glossary.md) terms: a Run is one Role executing against a Work Item, and a Shift is the whole attempt.

## Commands

- Run `mise run setup` once, then run every tool through `mise exec --`.
- Run `mise run verify` before delivery. It runs every application's gates and the cross-application qualification. Live-provider tests stay opt-in.
- Run `mise run docs-check` after changing anything under `docs/` or an application's `docs/`, and `mise run agents-check` after changing anything under `.apm/`.

## Rules

- Trunk is `development`.
- Unfold depends on a released [ploeg-hq/ploeg](https://github.com/ploeg-hq/ploeg) ([ADR-0039](https://github.com/unfold-hq/unfold/blob/development/docs/adr/adr-0039-unfold-depends-on-a-released-ploeg-through-its-contract-bundle-and-go-module.md)). `apps/ploeg` is its unpacked contract bundle; never edit it. Change Ploeg upstream.
- Unfold never executes new work types; until the engine is deleted, a managed execution never falls back to standalone.
- A deterministic demo says it is one and never invents model calls or spend.
- Keep each application's package, module, image and chart identities. [ADR-0020](https://github.com/unfold-hq/unfold/blob/development/docs/adr/adr-0020-unfold-is-the-application-and-the-name-vloer-is-retired.md) and [ADR-0055](https://github.com/unfold-hq/unfold/blob/development/docs/adr/adr-0055-github-unfold-hq-is-the-project-home.md) record the two exceptions.
- Never change production desired state as part of a repository refactor. It lives in the repository of the cluster that runs Unfold, not here.
- Code and executable tests describe the implementation. Label proposed behavior as proposed.

## Where things live

- Rules for one directory live in `.apm/instructions/<name>.instructions.md` with an `applyTo` glob; Claude Code gets them as `.claude/rules`, the other agents in that directory's generated `AGENTS.md`. Never edit a generated `AGENTS.md`.
- Before product, pricing, portal or tenancy work, read [Who Unfold is for](https://github.com/unfold-hq/unfold/blob/development/docs/concepts/who-unfold-is-for.md): self-hosted first, then a hosted service for agencies (system ADRs 0005–0010), none of it built yet.
- Shared guides start at [docs/index.md](https://github.com/unfold-hq/unfold/blob/development/docs/index.md); application contracts, ADRs and research stay inside the application.
- Before changing behavior that crosses Ploeg and Unfold, read [managed execution](https://github.com/unfold-hq/unfold/blob/development/docs/workflows/managed-execution.md).
- Before opening or reviewing a pull request, read [How work on Unfold is done](https://github.com/unfold-hq/unfold/blob/development/docs/contributing/way-of-working.md) and the [review guide](https://github.com/unfold-hq/unfold/blob/development/docs/contributing/review.md).
- Before adding an agent rule, skill or command, read [Agent instructions](https://github.com/unfold-hq/unfold/blob/development/docs/contributing/agent-instructions.md) for where it belongs.
